name: Ask More Photos — end-to-end (mobile web)
description: One positive journey: open the JDMart PDP, confirm the Ask More Photos CTA, submit the photo request through mobile-number + OTP login, and prove the CTA label changed. The workbook splits this across C01/C02/C03 and contains steps outside the journey; only the rows below are emitted.

exclude_rows.83: clear cookies — excluded by request (a fresh browser context is created per run anyway)
exclude_rows.87: popup-title verification — excluded by request; not in the requested journey
exclude_rows.91: resend-OTP verification — excluded by request; not in the requested journey
exclude_rows.93: click OtpSubmitButton — EXCLUDED ON LIVE EVIDENCE: the OTP field auto-submits on the sixth digit. Screenshot afp_04_otp_entered shows the popup already closed and 'Connecting...' displayed before any Login click, and the click failed twice with two different selectors because no button remained.
exclude_rows.94: success-toaster wait — excluded by request; not in the requested journey
exclude_rows.95: success-toaster text assertion — excluded by request; not in the requested journey

placeholders.${product_url}: suite parameter — DesignTest JDMart product page under test
placeholders.${jd_test_mobile}: secure runtime config (JD_TEST_MOBILE) — never stored in this file
placeholders.${jd_test_static_otp}: secure runtime config (JD_TEST_STATIC_OTP) — never stored in this file

84.why: Verify Ask More Photos is present

84.statement: verify element ask_more_photos_cta has text "Ask More Photos"
84.why: Verify the CTA has the expected initial text "Ask More Photos"
Capture evidence: PDP loaded, CTA present with initial text

86.why: Capture evidence: login popup open, mobile field present

89.why: Capture evidence: OTP screen reached after submitting the number

92.why: Capture evidence: six digits entered — OTP auto-submits here

end.statement: wait until element ask_more_photos_cta text is not "Ask More Photos"
end.why: Wait for the CTA text to change after submission
end.note: the CTA stays visible while its label changes, so a visibility wait would return too early

end.statement: store text of ask_more_photos_cta as updated_cta_text
end.why: Capture the actual updated CTA text

end.statement: verify stored updated_cta_text is not "Ask More Photos"
end.why: Verify the CTA text is no longer Ask More Photos
end.note: proves the label changed, whatever it changed to

end.why: Verify the CTA shows the expected submitted label "Photos Requested"
end.note: expected value supplied by the operator; NOT yet DOM-observed. Case- and spacing-sensitive.

notes: The exact post-submission CTA label has NOT been DOM-observed. 'Photos Requested' is operator-supplied; the actual text is captured and reported on execution.

stages.name: otp
stages.side_effect: submits the test mobile number, which sends one real OTP SMS
